name: fonts
title: Gamestage fonts
description: DM Sans for interface text and Unbounded for numbers a player tracks (score, timer, rank, multiplier, level), linked from Google Fonts. Kept in a separate stylesheet so a customer with their own typeface can replace the font loading without forking the components. Renders nothing, creates no DOM and sets no root attribute: it loads font faces and does not apply the token styles. `tokens` lists this item as a registry dependency, so installing tokens installs it too, and the fonts stylesheet is imported before the tokens stylesheet. For a customer typeface, supply that font stylesheet and override the font tokens rather than importing this one.
docs: Imports DM Sans (interface text, weights 400-900) and Unbounded (numbers a player tracks, weights 500-900) from Google Fonts, mirroring examples/lab/index.html. Import gamestage-fonts.css once at the root, before gamestage-tokens.css. The `font` block is metadata: the installer reads it for nothing, and the Google Fonts `@import` in gamestage-fonts.css is the only loading mechanism this item ships. `font.import` is blank because BDS-005 decided to link Google Fonts rather than self-host the family. Self-hosting was considered and deferred: linking is one line and a third-party request on every page load, self-hosting is a licence question and roughly 300KB; revisit at the stage 11 cold-load budget work.
